papers.title: Scanning strategies for texture and anisotropy tailoring during selective laser melting of TiC/316L stainless steel nanocomposites
papers.first_author_affiliation: School of Engineering and Applied Science, Harvard University, Cambridge, MA 02138, USA

corresponding_authors.name: Bandar AlMangour
corresponding_authors.affiliation: School of Engineering and Applied Science, Harvard University, Cambridge, MA 02138, USA

llm.relevance_to_user: 该论文研究SLM中扫描策略对复合材料织构和各项异性的影响，不涉及生物医用植入物或骨整合。
llm.why_not_core: This paper does not address any biomedical context, porous structures, stress shielding, fatigue, or osseointegration relevant to AM biomedical materials.

summary_zh.motivation: 为了通过扫描策略调控SLM成形TiC/316L纳米复合材料的织构和各项异性。
summary_zh.method: 采用不同扫描策略（如旋转角度、条带扫描）制备复合材料并表征其显微组织和力学性能。
summary_zh.result: 发现扫描策略显著影响织构和各项异性，优化策略可提高力学性能各向同性。
summary_zh.validation: 通过EBSD和拉伸测试验证了织构和各项异性的变化。

summary_en.motivation: To tailor texture and anisotropy in SLM-fabricated TiC/316L stainless steel nanocomposites through scanning strategies.
summary_en.method: Various scanning strategies (e.g., rotation angles, stripe scanning) were employed to fabricate composites, followed by microstructural and mechanical characterization.
summary_en.result: Scanning strategy significantly influenced texture and anisotropy; optimized strategies improved mechanical isotropy.
summary_en.validation: Texture and anisotropy were validated via EBSD and tensile testing.
